reopenEvidence.note: No AF was rejected. If a condition is disputed, the gate reopens only with the evidence named here.
reopenEvidence.AF-01: Evidence that the gate-event payload cannot be made truthful without a provider call, or that the unregistered-code message fallback is unnecessary because no bare-code error can reach a terminal path.
reopenEvidence.AF-02: A demonstrated EventSource client that delivers unlisted named frames (contradicting the browser probe), or a product requirement to keep a local list instead of the shared registry.
reopenEvidence.AF-04: A recipe that returns the newest window for >window runs after the cursor and passes the boundary tests; or evidence that concurrent appends cannot occur on /events in any supported client.
reopenEvidence.AF-05: A source-of-truth change that makes run_snapshots.limits per-run instead of global (would require a new snapshot design and evidence).
reopenEvidence.AF-06: Evidence that a Node errno code must be persisted as a run error code, or that the 31 unregistered codes must be registered (a separate registry decision).
reopenEvidence.AF-07: Evidence that markStartupInterrupted can never race (so the conditional guard can be dropped) and that test-side log writes to data/logs are acceptable.
reopenEvidence.AF-08: A product decision that the aggregate looseItems card should be fixed in this batch (it is out of scope here).
reopenEvidence.AF-09: A paid plan-agent run proving the runtime contract, or a product decision to validate text/candidate-draft (out of scope here).
reopenEvidence.AF-10: A requirement to persist check.code/durationMs (would need a migration; out of scope here).
reopenEvidence.AF-11: A consumer that requires reason to always be present (would require a truthful default sentence and a contract change).
